convertibility_reason: Grid-style averaging-down strategy where additional positions are opened at fixed pip intervals against the trend. SL/TP are dynamically recalculated based on averaged entry price across multiple positions. Uses OnTradeTransaction for deal tracking. Multi-position management with dynamic SL recalculation makes simple auto-conversion insufficient.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Fixed lot size per entry. Additional positions opened at pip step intervals (InpStep=30 pips) from last entry. Step can increase with position count: MathPow(positions_total,InpIncreaseStep)*InpStep when InpIncreaseStep>0. This is an averaging-down/averaging-up grid system.

custom_logic_notes: Mean-reversion channel strategy: EMA shifted by a percentage forms upper and lower bands. When price breaks below the lower band, buy; when above the upper band, sell. If price continues against the position, additional positions are opened at fixed pip intervals (averaging down/up). When multiple positions exist, SL and TP are recalculated based on the averaged entry price. There is a minimum time gap between entries (2 bar periods). Friday trading can be disabled via InpTradeOnFriday. OnTradeTransaction tracks last position close time for potential use. The SL for averaged positions is divided by the number of positions (ExtStopLoss/positions_total), effectively tightening the SL as more positions are added.
python_conversion_notes: Grid/averaging strategy with dynamic position management requires careful implementation. Key challenges: (1) Multi-position tracking with magic number filtering, (2) Dynamic SL/TP recalculation based on averaged price when positions_total>1, (3) Step distance between positions that can scale with position count via MathPow, (4) Time gate preventing entries within 2 bar periods of last entry, (5) Friday trading filter, (6) OnTradeTransaction handler tracking deal close times, (7) SL for averaged positions is ExtStopLoss/positions_total not full ExtStopLoss per position - this is critical for correct P&L. Position sizing is fixed lots per grid level, not risk-based. Must handle 3/5 digit broker adjustment for all pip values.
